content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Result: MISSING (critical) — no Vendor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement.**

- Section 7 is headed "LIMITATIONS OF LIABILITY; INDEMNIFICATION OF CONTRACTOR" but contains only liability caps (7(a)), a consequential-damages waiver (7(b)) and an attorneys'-fees waiver (7(c)). Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless", "defend" and third-party claim language returned no operative indemnity.
- Section 5(c)'s non-infringement warranty is not a substitute — it does not fund the defence or damages of a third-party IP claim.
- No Company-side indemnity exists either, so nothing needed narrowing.

**Cure (fallback target, one insert as new 7(d)):** Contractor IP indemnity for third-party infringement/misappropriation claims, with the customary Company-modification, combination and specification exclusions; procure/modify/replace remedies with a refund of fees paid if none is commercially available; and a super-cap of three times annual fees expressed to apply notwithstanding the 7(a) fees-paid cap (a conforming replace of 7(a) was not permitted for a missing-clause finding, so the override sits inside the new cap sentence). Preferred-level extras (affiliates, breach of law, data breach, misconduct, claim procedure) were deliberately not added at this level.
